decisions.reason: 가문 is families, not generic factions; matches the established Family rendering.
Keeps 내게 and the hole-boring force of 뚫어져라 노려보는; intently is weaker and drops to me.
바라봤다 is looked; stared upgrades a verb the source already distinguished from 노려보다.
Keeps the spilled-water proverb and its link to the teacup; What’s done is done flattens the image.
Taken command is the natural English for 지휘봉을 들었다; taken up command is slightly off.
본가 here is the main-family compound; family estate drops 본.
동틀 무렵 is around dawn, and 펼쳐졌다 is spread, not thrown over.
파하다 is adjourn, but 긴장된 분위기 must stay; amid that tension drops atmosphere.
decisions.replacement: When the family council finally adjourned in that tense atmosphere, Jin Wikyung, Wipeng, and I moved to the Lesser Family Head’s office.

decisions.reason: BASE’s crying at words is awkward; SOL’s damn adds profanity 억울해서다 does not have.
decisions.replacement: Jin Wikyung’s warm words almost brought tears to my eyes. Not because I was moved, but because it felt so unfair.

decisions.reason: 그 marks that specific someday-event, not a generic something; since fits 말이 나왔으니.
왜 그러나 after 그런데 주군 is What is it?, not a bare Why?
내팽개쳤다 is active discarding of thoughts; vanished loses agency and collapses 인물 among NPCs.
Standalone opened my mouth is body-part translationese merged into the ask.
I cautiously asked naturalizes 입을 열었다 without losing 조심스럽게.
types and kinds are interchangeable for 부류; no gain.
무겁게 끄덕이다 here is a grave nod, not a physically heavy one.
Restores 장로원이라는 손발 as limbs, echoing hands and feet; BASE omitted it.
정확한 사실은 알 수 없지만 is exact truth, not we cannot know for certain; 분명해 is certain.
So had I is tighter for 나도 그랬다, but SOL drops 화법 and recasts 물러나다 as stop.
decisions.replacement: So had I. But that had merely been the Head Elder’s clever way of speaking—a suggestion that perhaps we should back down at this point.

decisions.reason: 그 제안 is that proposal; 결과 is result, not a looser the proposal/outcome swap.
일어났겠지 is would have broken out; there would have been flattens the eruption.
Impersonal 지면 죽음이고 fits defeat/death; avoids BASE’s until and tremendous, and keeps 계속 in kept killing.
A hyena of a politician is the natural English of 하이에나 같은 정치인 without losing the image.
짐작 is guess, not conjecture; 상황 is the situation, not a crisis; spoken register fits.
Keeps 썩 and 도: not exactly, either; SOL drops both.
이야기를 꺼냈다 is brought up the subject; situation over-specifies 이야기.
Need 상황도 좋지 않습니다 either, glossary 본가 as our family, and 추락 as plummeting.
decisions.replacement: “The situation is not good, either. According to our outside sources, rumors that Lee Seogeun was poisoned have begun spreading, and our family’s reputation is plummeting.”

decisions.reason: 빠르군 is a present observation, not That was fast.
이상한 일이다 is strange, not something was definitely wrong.
자작극 is a staged act; scheme staged adds scheme and loses 극.
가급적 is if possible; SOL omits it.
반신반의 plus 모양 is unsure what to believe, and 민심 vs 문파 supports common people.
수포로 돌아간 is came to nothing, not merely failed.
just carries the exasperated 이건 in 갈수록 최악인데 이건.
바라보고 is looking; staring upgrades the verb.
홰치는 소리 is beating wings; flutter understates 푸드득/홰치다.
것 같은데요 is a tentative question that a reply has arrived, not a flat we got.
Plaque and slackened fit 현판/늘어트렸다, but 삼엄한 기세 is a stern aura, not imposing auras.
decisions.replacement: As the carriage approached the grand plaque bearing those words in magnificent calligraphy and the martial artists guarding the main gate with a stern aura, the coachman slackened the reins.

decisions.reason: 정지 shouted as a halt is Stop! in English.
크게 외치며 is shouted, and his voice was tense is cleaner for 긴장감이 배어 있었다.
더군다나 is What was more, not More than that.
범상치 않다 is not yet visitor; SOL over-specifies before 손님.
Keeps 준마 and renders 화려함 as splendor rather than luxury.
낯이 익은데 is the whole arrival; they matches the following coachman and carriage.
마부도 그렇고. 마차도 그렇고 is deliberate repetition SOL flattens.
눈매 then 눈빛 is eyes then gaze; visitor matches 손님 and the earlier 범상치 않다 payoff.
내려앉았다 is alighted, but 사뿐히 is lightly, not gracefully, and the ground stays.
decisions.replacement: The carriage door opened, and a red silk slipper alighted lightly onto the ground.

decisions.reason: 매혹적인 is enchanting, stronger and closer than charming.
halfway to my feet is the natural English for 엉거주춤 일어선 채로.
나, 진태경의 distances the little-finger tie onto Jin Taekyung, which my flattens.
누나가 왜 거기서 나와 is the meme; SOL replaces the joke with a generic why are you here.
Parallel 웃음소리도 예쁘고 is better as her laugh was beautiful, but 더 예뻐 is became, not looked.
decisions.replacement: Wolhwa giggled. She was beautiful, her laugh was beautiful, and when a beautiful woman laughed, she became even more beautiful…

decisions.reason: 잔뜩 숨죽인 목소리로 is a tightly restrained voice; lowered to a whisper drops 숨죽인.
이런 분위기에 is this atmosphere, not a generic now.
불렀다 is called for, not summoned; 상상만 해도 is one beat, and at a time like this is extra.
decisions.replacement: The entire family was on high alert. If word got out that I had called for a courtesan, just imagining what would happen to my reputation made my vision swim.

decisions.reason: I get it and what are you trying to pull, barging in match panicked spoken 알겠으니까 / 갑자기 와서 뭐 하자는.
더럽게 안 좋다 is damn awful, not sanitized couldn’t have been worse; office-first order matches 집무실에서 기다리는.
decisions.replacement: The timing was damn awful, too. I was in the Lesser Family Head’s office waiting for a guest from a sect called the Lower District Sect.

decisions.reason: 가실 거래요 is reported she says she’s leaving, which BASE drops.
볼일 있어서 온 거거든 is I’m here on business; attend to is padding.
오늘부터 is from today; 빨리 나가요 is hurry up and leave.
decisions.replacement: “Don’t call me ‘our Young Master Jin.’ I’m going to live chastely from today onward. I don’t have any business with you anymore, so hurry up and leave.”

decisions.reason: 싫은데 is I don’t want to, not a flat No.
번쩍 들어서 is presented as the hoist; tried to telegraphs the failure before 응?
왜 안 들려 is lift-specific; budge generalizes the failed hoist.
weighed a ton is the natural comic English for 무게가 많이 나가나.
몇인데 is a rhetorical how high, not a forgetful what was it again; 하나 is a single.
미치겠다, 진짜 echoes the earlier driving me insane; SOL replaces the line.
웃겨 죽는 is laughed herself to death; doubled over adds a pose and drops 죽는.
지금까지의 모습과는 달랐다 is different from how she had been; completely is added.
벙어리 삼룡이 is the name Mute Samryong, not a lowercase mute label.
제발 그러지 마 is Please don’t, not a trailing Please.
There’s one person I haven’t been introduced to is the natural English of 한 분 소개를 못 들은.
Naturalizes 입을 열었다 into speech while keeping 피를 토하는 심정.
네에 is drawn-out Yeees, but 저도 잘 부탁드려요 is I hope we get along too, not a generic A pleasure.
decisions.replacement: “Yeees. I hope we get along too, Young Master Jin.”

decisions.reason: Spoken He’s and 본 문 as our sect fit her voice better than He is / this sect.
풉 is a snort BASE omitted; 본론 is getting down to business.
시원시원한 is refreshingly direct; finally changes 도 from also to at last.
감사를 표하오 is sincere thanks; gratitude is a same-sense synonym with no gain.
이유 is singular; 필요하다면 is if necessary; 이득을 위해서 is for our sect’s benefit.
좋소 is Good, not the more contractual Agreed.
나섰지만 can be stepping forward; interjected narrows it to speech only.
월화도 is also, not even, which adds unexpectedness.
결정이 빠르시군요 is this decision; make decisions sounds habitual.
가문의 모든 걸 걸었으니까 is I staked everything the family has; SOL shifts the agent to the family.
아버님 to an outsider is my father; bare Father reads as in-family address.
정보가 빠르군 is idiomatic as information travels fast, not information is fast.
살아남으려면, 수완, and 이라도 are if you want to survive, resourcefulness, and at least; BASE drops at least and uses generic skills.
Watching…, a thought occurred is a dangling participle; I suddenly had a thought keeps the watcher.
장미가 생각났다 is roses came to mind; a rose is an unforced singular.
Footnote should name Mute Samryong as the character, matching the in-text rendering.
